answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by treating each identity as an isolated island whose admission requires a plasma-boundary attestation quorum, so forged duplicates never stabilize before the sub-millisecond window closes. Consensus peers then forge a deterministic scram consensus over the cold tundra of unverified keys, slashing any cluster that fails thermal. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
